CustomField.formula:
IF(TEXT(Status__c) = "Partially Approved",
IF(ISBLANK(Requested_Discounted_Selling_Price_1__c), 0, Opportunity_Product_1__r.ListPrice - Approved_Price_1__c) + IF(ISBLANK(Requested_Discounted_Selling_Price_2__c), 0, Opportunity_Product_2__r.ListPrice - Approved_Price_2__c) + IF(ISBLANK(Requested_Discounted_Selling_Price_3__c), 0, Opportunity_Product_3__r.ListPrice - Approved_Price_3__c) + IF(ISBLANK(Requested_Discounted_Selling_Price_4__c), 0, Opportunity_Product_4__r.ListPrice - Approved_Price_4__c) + IF(ISBLANK(Requested_Discounted_Selling_Price_5__c), 0, Opportunity_Product_5__r.ListPrice - Approved_Price_5__c) + IF(ISBLANK(Requested_Discounted_Selling_Price_6__c), 0, Opportunity_Product_6__r.ListPrice - Approved_Price_6__c) + IF(ISBLANK(Requested_Discounted_Selling_Price_7__c), 0, Opportunity_Product_7__r.ListPrice - Approved_Price_7__c) + IF(ISBLANK(Requested_Discounted_Selling_Price_8__c), 0, Opportunity_Product_8__r.ListPrice - Approved_Price_8__c) + IF(ISBLANK(Requested_Discounted_Selling_Price_9__c), 0, Opportunity_Product_9__r.ListPrice - Approved_Price_9__c),
IF(TEXT(Status__c) = "Approved", Total_Discount_Requested__c, 0 ))
CustomField.label: Total Approved Discount
